name: SLAM · Study
description: Study notes on single-robot SLAM and state estimation, branch by branch: recursive Bayes filters (histogram filter, particle filter, MCL), scan registration (ICP, NDT), feature extraction (DBSCAN), filter-based SLAM (EKF-SLAM, FastSLAM, GMapping, FAST-LIO) and graph-based SLAM (SPA, pose graphs, Cartographer), with interactive visualizations and C++/Python implementations.
